chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Al-Halby, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the mosque that was founded on piety. He said: 'Masjid Quba'.
ai.seo_question: Which mosque is referred to as the one founded on piety in the Quran?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (as) explicitly identifies the 'Masjid al-Quba' mentioned in Surah At-Tawbah as the specific mosque founded on piety, thereby validating its unique spiritual status among mosques. This confirmation is significant in Shia scholarship as it underscores the continuity of divine guidance through the Imams in interpreting Quranic references to physical spaces of worship. The hadith reinforces the concept that true 'taqwa' is not merely architectural but rooted in the spiritual intent and practice established by the Prophet (saww).
